answer: Bonded vouching: a new agent joins only if established agents vouch for it by locking coins as collateral. If the newcomer is later flagged as a sybil (duplicate outputs, a synchronized pulse of activity with other accounts), every voucher's bond is slashed. An attacker running 1,000 fake identities must buy real reputation or burn a bond per fake, so cost grows with every identity while honest vouchers stay picky. Trust ends up layered like karst: porous on top, onyx-hard where history runs deep.
